_comment: The live overlay register. adjustment_set_version 91, in force 2026-09-19.
matrix_version 214 with overlay set 91 and matrix_version 214 with overlay
set 87 are DIFFERENT CONFIGURATIONS and are recorded as such (spec §6).
Every entry carries eleven mandatory fields. There is no optional one. An
overlay without a review_date does not validate; an overlay without a
stack_position does not validate; an overlay whose target is not a
registered surface is rejected and the attempt is recorded.

overlays.description: Agency-placed accounts score optimistically; the model has not seen a full placement cycle.
overlays.rationale: Observed 90-day roll rate on agency-placed accounts runs 31% above prediction for two consecutive quarters.

overlays.description: Unsecured book deterioration for the quarter.
overlays.rationale: Macro view; unsecured early-life roll up 19% quarter on quarter.
overlays._stack_note: 4101 then 4102 is NOT the same answer as 4102 then 4101 — a points shift before an odds multiplier compounds differently. stack_position makes the order a declared property of the SET, so it cannot become emergent from file order or dict iteration.

overlays.description: Move the band 3/4 edge by 0.03 of roll probability on the unsecured book.
overlays.rationale: Re-cuts band 4 to catch the deterioration in 4102 without re-keying the whole matrix.
overlays._capacity_note: Computed by running allocation/ over the reference population, not typed into the approval form. Required field on this surface only.

overlays.description: Escalate bucket 3 by one intensity level for six weeks.
overlays.rationale: Bucket 3 roll-to-4 up 14% since the August matrix release; a tilt while the October matrix is reviewed.
overlays._feasibility_note: Spec §5.9: an intensity dial that raises demand 20% on a saturated pool may deliver no additional contacts at all, and the forum that approved it is entitled to be told that. 41 800 accounts drop below the cut-off as a CONSEQUENCE of this overlay and that number is on the approval record.

overlays.description: Suspend field visits for the quarter.
overlays.rationale: Field partner contract under renegotiation; 2 600 daily recommendations redirect to the late-agent pool.
overlays._lapse_warning: review_date is in three days. on_review_date_lapsed = expire_and_alert: on 2026-09-23 this overlay stops applying, field visits resume at the matrix's own recommendation, and every affected account records overlay_lapsed_ids = [4204]. The commercial tilt reverts; the approved artefact wins.

overlays.description: Lengthen cooling-off on SMS in balance band 1 after a complaints spike.
overlays.rationale: Complaints from low-balance clients up 40% month on month.
overlays._combiner_note: TIGHTEN_ONLY(increase). Base cooling-off for these cells is 4 days, so this resolves to 7. Had the forum approved 2, it would resolve to 4 and be recorded as applied-with-no-effect. Neither the forum nor the author can loosen a cooling-off period through this surface.

overlays.description: Dial agent-call allocation up 20% in balance bands 6-7.
overlays.rationale: High-balance recovery per agent hour exceeds the book average by 3.4x.
overlays._rejection_example: The forum's first proposal was 1.45x. It was REJECTED at authoring with: 'allocation.weight overlay would breach fairness floor untouched_days_floor: 3 910 accounts in buckets 3-8 would exceed 21 days without contact (limit 0). Reduce the multiplier to at most 1.23 or request a deliberate relaxation of the floor through Collections Operations.' Spec §5.9.

lapsed.description: Escalate bucket 5 by one level during the March collections push.
lapsed._note: Retained in the register after expiry, not deleted. 'Which overlays were in force on 12 March 2026' is answerable from this file alone.

rejected_attempts._note: Spec §5.4: 'the attempted definition is itself recorded'. This block is part of the register, is retained for seven years, and is on the standing report that goes to Compliance.
